schema_gap: No current table is image-asset-level and simultaneously records an observation/inference, the exact source-content SHA-256, model/observer identity, and analysis-definition version.

design_reference_observation is reference-level, has no image_asset foreign key, no source-content SHA-256, no observer/model or analysis-version fields, and cannot preserve append-only AI output plus a later human correction.

design_assessment and visual_communication_reference are each one row per reference and therefore cannot represent multiple image-level analyses, content states, or review events without destructive replacement.

entities: image_visual_observation: one append-only assertion about one image_asset at one SHA-256 content state and one analysis-definition version; a human correction is a new row that references the prior row through supersedes_observation_id.
fields: source_content_sha256 (64-character hex SHA-256 for the analyzed bytes)
observation_type (controlled extensible vocabulary, versioned by analysis_version; for example material_appearance, bead_shape, composition, lighting)
observed_value (one atomic textual value per row)
producer_id (model identifier or human reviewer identifier)
supersedes_observation_id (nullable self-FK; used only for a later correction/review assertion)
constraints: FOREIGN KEY image_asset_id REFERENCES image_asset(id); FOREIGN KEY supersedes_observation_id REFERENCES image_visual_observation(id).

CHECK source_content_sha256 is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters; check all controlled class, scope and confidence values; require nonblank observation_type, observed_value, producer_id and analysis_version.
Insertion guard must require source_content_sha256 to equal the referenced image_asset.image_hash at creation time. Old rows remain attached to their historical SHA if asset bytes later change.

AI producers may insert only assertion_class observation or inference; confirmed facts are not Vision output and must be represented through existing evidence-backed canonical structures after human/source review.

Use append-only correction rows with supersedes_observation_id; do not overwrite the original AI row. A logical idempotency key should prevent exact duplicate reruns for the same asset SHA, analysis version, producer, class, type and value.

existing_structures_reused: image_asset for stable asset identity and cryptographic image_hash (SHA-256 exact-content identity): migrations/006_p1c_image_assets.sql, table image_asset; docs/schema.md image-asset section.
design_reference_image for asset-to-reference linkage and existing image_role values including promotional: migrations/006_p1c_image_assets.sql, table design_reference_image.

design_reference_observation for later reference-level synthesis and evidence-backed confirmed material linkage, not for raw Vision rows: migrations/001_initial.sql, table design_reference_observation.

visual_communication_reference for reference-level promotional synthesis, not per-image Vision output: migrations/001_initial.sql, table visual_communication_reference; docs/schema.md visual-communication separation.
image_perceptual_hash as the existing content-state/versioning precedent: migrations/007_p2a_perceptual_hash.sql, source_content_sha256 plus algorithm_version.
important_semantic_boundaries: A direct visible statement is an observation; an appearance-based identity statement is an inference; neither is a confirmed fact.

Confirmed material fact remains distinct: existing design_reference_observation requires identification_status='confirmed' together with confirmed_material_variant_id; a Vision result must not set either.
image_visual_observation is image-level. Reference-level synthesis remains in design_reference_observation, design_assessment, or visual_communication_reference only after a separate, explicit step.
observation_scope separates product_design from promotional_visual; promotional visual language must not become a product-design claim.
source_content_sha256 plus analysis_version makes an output traceable to both image bytes and analysis definition.
risks: Reusing design_reference_observation would collapse several image assets into a reference-level row and lose the exact analyzed image state.
Reusing design_assessment or visual_communication_reference would make reruns and human corrections destructive because each is unique per design reference.
A bare image_asset_id without source_content_sha256 would allow an old Vision result to appear applicable after asset bytes change.
A fixed column per visual attribute would prematurely freeze a vocabulary and create frequent schema migrations.
requires_gpt_decision: Approve or revise the one-table append-only image_visual_observation proposal before any migration is drafted.
Approve the initial controlled observation_type vocabulary and the analysis_version naming convention for the next ten-image Vision pilot.
Decide whether the insertion-time image-hash equality rule is enforced by a SQLite trigger (stronger) or by the approved writer path plus a regression test (lighter).
